name: taskmaster-suite
description: Meta-bundle (30 plugins): the full clarification-to-execution workflow plus its wired companions — taskmaster, task-runner, stack-scan, code-architecture, the review and process plugins (code-review, git-workflow, orchestration, approaches, and the rest), and the ui-ux agents the pipeline's visual cards route to. Uninstall cleanly with /taskmaster-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
